title: Drag Race Case
summary: The Drag Race Case is a named set that has gone by many names throughout the years, despite the set itself being the same concept. It was introduced as part of the Sto & Go series, a line that would transform small sets into tracks. In this instance, the Drag Race Case was a case that you could walk around with and carry up to 20 Hot Wheel cars.
